Overall Summary

As CNC Programmer, you will create programs for CNC equipment using CAD/CAM software. You will improve and optimize machining processes by reviewing material removal rates for optimum tool life and increased efficiency and ensure successful completion of CNC programming goals set forth by management.

Your duties will include:

• Create and maintain multi-axis CNC programs to produce parts using CAD/CAM software. Experience utilizing Vericut, or UG/MasterCam optimization tools is a plus.

• Experience in developing and implementing solutions in a regulated production manufacturing process.

• Develop CNC machining processes by selecting the chucking device, cutting tools, tool arrangement, and cutting speeds and feeds with emphasis on standardization.

• Perform CNC program prove outs on the machine tool and correct the programs as required.

• Prepare detailed work instructions and supervise machining process validations including operator training. Communicate effectively with Manufacturing Engineering, Product Development Engineering, plant personnel, and individuals outside the company.

• Implement and report cost improvements.

• Assist in the design of jigs, tools, fixtures, and special equipment for CNC applications.

• Ensure compliance with current CNC programming standards and best practices.

• Assist in the selection of new equipment.

• Follow all programming file management procedures, set by the company and/or applicable Quality Specifications to ensure compliance of CNC programs with our Quality Management System.

• Function as subject matter expert and mentor for other programmers and machinists.

• Other Duties: Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

About You

We might be a great match if you...

...possess a broad background and knowledge of many manufacturing processes to perform this job.  Experience with CNC machining, manual machining, metal finishing/grinding and assembly is required. Must have a working knowledge of CAD/CAM systems and be familiar with 3D models.

YOUR EDUCATION

Required: High School Diploma or GED

Preferred: Associate’s Degree or Technical School completion in related field

YOUR EXPERIENCE

With High School Diploma or GED: Minimum five years of CNC programming experience to include three years’ experience using CAD/CAM software.

With Associate’s Degree or Tech School Completion: Minimum 3 years related experience required.

Multi axis Mill/Turn and robotic experience is a plus.

Why You’ll Love MicroPort

You will find our team atmosphere challenging and rewarding. In addition to working with a world-class team, receiving a competitive base salary and bonus opportunities, our U.S. employees also enjoy the following benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, Maternity Leave, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, Bereavement, 401(k) (up to 4% match with vesting from day 1), PTO, Paid Holidays, Employee Assistance Program, Education Assistance...and more! At MicroPort, we care about our employees and encourage them to make healthy lifestyle choices and embrace wellness opportunities to maintain their very best health and wellbeing.

Overall Summary

As a Sr. Machinist, you will work with tools, fixtures, and machines to manufacture medical devices from setup to operation. A working knowledge of manual machines (i.e., mills, lathes, grinders) and the ability to operate computer numerical controlled (CNC) machines is utilized to produce large volumes of medical devices made from metals, plastics or other materials.

Your duties will include:

• Operate multiple CNC/Manual machines such as mills and lathes.

• Manufacture medical devices that conform to specifications and all Quality Assurance requirements such as calipers, micrometers, coordinate measuring machines, optical comparators, air gages, surface roundness and finish analyzers.

• Attain production quotas such as daily goals, team goals, and labor standards.

• Complete device history records accurately with minimal errors.

• Enter required production data into MicroPort business systems.

• Perform routine preventive maintenance including area cleaning.

• Set-up and operate multiple CNC/Manual machines such as mills, lathes, and multi-axis CNC’s.

• Perform auxiliary production operations such as, but not limited to inspection, metal finishing, robot operation, issuing / receiving raw materials and components.

• Work with Engineering staff to develop, prove out, and improve production processes.

• Communicate with peers, management, and other departments to ensure optimal efficiency is achieved.

• Train other machinists in core job duties.

• Lead 6S projects and implement improvements to the process.

• Be proficient in the set up and operation of at least 3 different types of machines in 3 different work centers.

• Participate in team events, as well as individually contribute, to improve production efficiencies.

• Participate in the interview process for prospective machinists.

• Maintain a strong machining knowledge base to ensure optimal performance in any and all areas that present business needs.

Other Duties Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

We might be a great match if:

Sr. Machinists must be able to understand units of measure in both metric and English; must be able to convert between the two.  A basic understanding of manufacturing machines, metal deburring, and plastic trimming is required. The ability to use measurement tools such as calipers, micrometers and other specialty tools used in machining processes is required.

Minimal requirements for entry into the role are as follows:

• Some mechanical aptitude.

• Basic computer application skills.

• Basic blueprint reading skills.

• Basic metrology / measuring skills.

• Ability to read and write in English.

• Ability to operate within and sustain an organized work environment.

• Demonstrate company core values.

• Quality focused with a strong attention to detail.

• Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency.

• Motivated self-starter that works well independently or within teams.

Your Education:

Required: High School Diploma or GED

Preferred: Technical School Training

Your Experience:

5 years or 3 years & CNC Technical School Completion.

Overall Summary

As Maintenance Service Specialist, you will perform maintenance on both CNC and Manual equipment. The Maintenance Specialist will assist outside OEM technicians to gain experience in repairing and set-up of new equipment.

Your duties will include:

• Perform troubleshooting and evaluates mechanical, hydraulic, and electrical unit and controls to determine source of malfunction.

• Uses blueprints, machine specifications, and schematic drawings to determine repair procedures.

• Removes and replaces defective units, controls, or components. Tests and repairs components such as PC boards, power supplies, and controls stations with oscilloscopes, VOM’s, logic probe

• Adjusts sensitive electrical, thermal, and timing devices to machine specifications.

• Starts repaired and/or new equipment to verify readiness for operation.

• Complies with all health, safety and environmental policies, procedures.

• Must have valid current driver’s license to drive to local vendors for repair parts and supplies.

• Perform preventive maintenance on all equipment.

• Assist outside contractors, i.e.: fire systems, insurance inspectors, etc.

• Responsible for monitoring all daily Industrial Wastewater Discharge Points (pH pits and Outfalls)

Other Duties: Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

About You

We might be a great match if you have:

• Ability to replace ball screws, servo motors, solenoid valve, control boards.

• Willingness to obtain aerial and forklift license within the first year after starting.

• Proficiency in soldering, welding, and fabricating.

• VOM, clamp on Ammeter, Hammers, pliers, and wrenches.

Licensure, Registration and/or Certification

Driver’s license is required

Current forklift and aerial license required or must be willing to obtain forklift and aerial license within first 6 months of hire.

YOUR EDUCATION

Required: High School Diploma or GED

Preferred: Associate's Degree in Industrial Maintenance Technology or related technical field strongly preferred

YOUR EXPERIENCE

I: At least 1 year experience as a Machine Maintenance Technician involving electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems, including repairing CNC equipment OR minimum one year experience as Machinist.

II: At least 3 years' experience as a Machine Maintenance Technician involving electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems, including repairing CNC equipment.

This is a 2nd shift position: 3:00-11:30pm (Monday-Friday)

Shift Premium: 5% for 2nd shift

Overall Summary

As a Metal Finisher, you will metal finish medical devices to meet specifications, perform quality verification of medical devices, including non-destructive testing, laser mark medical devices, and operate machines used to metal finish including belt lathes, sandblast equipment, robots etc.

Your duties will include:

Metal Finisher I:
1. Operate sandblast/glass bead machines to meet quality and production requirements.
2. Ability to read and understand work instructions.
3. Operate measuring tools including: cmm, digital/optical comparators, Tally Round, air gages, calipers and micrometers.
4. Operate belt lathe machines to meet quality and production requirements.
5. Operate robotic machines to meet quality specifications and production requirements.
6. Correctly enter data into device history routers for the product produced.
7. Perform secondary operations required for production but not necessarily on a daily basis such as but not limited to: laser marking, work order completions.
8. Enter required production data into systems used by MicroPort for business purposes. (dbh, oee, Workman, Camstar etc.
9. Straighten with hydraulic press
10. Masking medical devices.

Metal Finisher II:
1. Perform penetrant inspection process to meet quality specifications and production requirements.
2. Perform required pm’s on machines and processes.
3. Train other employees to metal finish.
4. Electro polish process (if required for production)
5. Precision finishing.
6. 6S practices and skills

Sr. Metal Finisher: (only applies to internal candidates)
1. Welding (if required for production)
2. Proficiency in metal finishing in two of the following production areas tibs, fems, hips, job shop and prototypes.
3. Troubleshooting robot issues (if required for production)
4. Heat treating (if required for production)
5. Knowledge and experience in geometric dimensioning and tolerancing

Other Duties Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

About You

We might be a great match if you have:

• Some mechanical aptitude.

• Basic computer application skills.

• Basic blueprint reading skills.

• Basic metrology / measuring skills.

• Ability to read and write in English.

• Ability to operate within and sustain an organized work environment.

• Demonstration of company core values.

• A quality focus with a strong attention to detail.

• A strong work ethic with a sense of urgency.

• Motivated self-starter attitude and you work well independently or within teams.

YOUR EDUCATION

High School diploma or GED required

YOUR EXPERIENCE

Metal Finisher I: minimum 1 year of related experience or equivalent technical education

Metal Finisher II: minimum 2 years related experience.

Sr. Metal Finisher: (only applies to internal candidates) minimum 3 years related experience.
